name: error-constraint-int64-above-max-past-2p53
$comment: Int64 constraint bounds beyond 2^53: a value one above max = 2^62 (4611686018427387904) violates under exact i64 compare and must fail SCHEMA_VIOLATION. A float-parsing engine rounds the value 4611686018427387905 down to 2^62 and wrongly lets it pass (pre-fix ts/python divergence the corpus pins).
